content: ⌊ DRAFT g If NmPnEraCalcEnabled is TRUE and the stored value for a PNC is set to PNC requested or back to PNC released (see [SWS_Nm_00323] and [SWS_Nm_00326]), then Nm shall forward the changed state of ERA of the affected NM-channel to ComM by calling ComM_Nm_UpdateERA(<ComMChannel>, <PncBitVector of ERA>) .

If NmPnEraCalcEnabled is TRUE and the stored value for a PNC is set to PNC requested or back to PNC released (see [SWS_Nm_00323] and [SWS_Nm_00326]), then Nm shall forward the changed state of ERA of the affected NM-channel to ComM by calling ComM_Nm_UpdateERA(<ComMChannel>, <PncBitVector of ERA>) .
